ns2:course.label: Interaction Design Foundation
ns2:course.description: This 16-week course will immerse students in a series of assignments designed to help them develop a fundamental understanding of front-end web technologies, such as HTML5, CSS and JavaScript, and prepare them to plan and develop interactive experiences. Prerequisite: Completion of the First-Year Curriculum in Art & Design.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Completion of the First-Year Curriculum in Art & Design.
